Class GameBlockRendererCache

Namespace
OnixRuntime.Api.Rendering
Assembly
OnixRuntime.dll

IMPORTANT: You HAVE to Reset(BlockPos) the cache if you plan on making use of it, getting or setting any values out of it. This is what the GameBlockRenderer goes to everytime it needs a block. This lets you cheat by changing the cache yourself to manipulate the rendering. Very notably, UseOccluder needs to be properly setup in order to work. Now this cache has a 20x20x20 area. You don't want to be rendering blocks outside of that. This cache is meant to contain a subchunk and two blocks outwards. You reset it with the starting position of your subchunk (+15 x,y,z should be the last/end position of the subchunk). Often, you will want the edges of your chunks to not be culled, so you can call SurroundInAir(bool, bool, bool) after resetting it to make it believe the edges are air.

Reset(BlockPos)

This resets the cache to an empty state, you should call this before doing anything with the cache. This will do -2 to the position you add to it, so you should just give it the start of your subchunk. This is obviously made to render subchunks, but if you're just rendering a single block, you can just give it that position as is. When rendering a subchunk, if you want the sides to render too, you can call SurroundInAir(bool, bool, bool) after this to make it believe the edges are air.

SurroundInAir(bool, bool, bool)

Warning: Make sure the cache has been reset with a logical position for what you're trying to do before using this function. This surrounds the sub chunk in air, only in the cache of course, making it so that the edges of your subchunk will render properly when using UseOccluder. Complete is just if you have messed with the cache before and need a complete reset of the edges to air. I would say only use complete if you see issues at the edge of the chunks and do more than only Reset(BlockPos) and SurroundInAir(bool, bool, bool).

public void SurroundInAir(bool sides = true, bool topAndBottom = true, bool complete = false)

Parameters

sides bool

True if you want the sides to be surrounded by air.

topAndBottom bool

True if you want the top and bottom faces to be surrounded

complete bool

Whether to do a complete reset of the edges to air.
